SELECT json_agg(x) AS r FROM (
  SELECT c.name AS empresa,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(w.unread_count,0) > 0) AS nao_lidas,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(w.unread_count,0) > 0 AND w.last_message_from_me) AS ultima_da_equipe,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(w.unread_count,0) > 0 AND NOT coalesce(w.last_message_from_me, false) AND w.last_message_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS cliente_esperando_7d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.unread_count = 99) AS marcadas_ia
  FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN companies c ON c.id = w.company_id
  WHERE c.name IN ('Castelo da Diversão','Mega Magic','Planeta Divertido')
  GROUP BY 1
) x
